fields.title: Fix ShardId as a 16-bit integer
fields.decision: Use a 16-bit integer (Int16/short) for every ShardId rather than a generic ShardId type.
fields.context: Earlier releases allowed the shard identifier to use a generic type such as string, byte, or Guid. Within a project that type could not change, yet consumers had to repeatedly declare it.

alternatives.whyRejected: It produced a verbose, unnecessarily complex object model and redundant client code without a per-project flexibility benefit.

fields.consequences: Shard identifiers are compact in storage and memory while theoretically supporting more than 65,000 shards; the consuming object model is simpler.
